classifications.rationale: This is a historical recital describing prior invitations, possible future presidential action, and earlier agreements; it neither presently directs an actor nor changes import treatment.
classifications.evidence: I may remove or modify the restriction on steel article imports from that country

classifications.rationale: This recounts a prior presidential determination and exclusion, plus planned monitoring, without itself producing a new legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: I determined that steel article imports from Brazil would no longer threaten to impair the national security

classifications.rationale: The President recounts an internal monitoring and reporting direction to the Secretary; any later adjustment would require a separate action.
classifications.evidence: directed the Secretary to monitor implementation of quantitative limitations applicable to steel article imports from Brazil

classifications.rationale: The United States is committed to producing a specified later reduction in an existing quantitative import limitation for the remainder of 2020.
classifications.evidence: the United States will lower, for the remainder of 2020, one of the quantitative limitations

classifications.rationale: This passage recounts or explains a tariff-exclusion decision, future consultations, and anticipated commercial effects rather than itself imposing a new operative consequence.
classifications.evidence: The United States and Brazil will hold further consultations in December 2020

classifications.rationale: The President states a determination to direct the Secretary to grant specified relief later under conditions supplied below; the legal relief occurs through the Secretary's subsequent grants.
classifications.evidence: I have determined to direct the Secretary to provide relief from the quantitative limitation

classifications.rationale: The President presently establishes the annual aggregate import limit applicable to Brazil for calendar year 2020.
classifications.evidence: the annual aggregate limit for Brazil set out in the Annex to this proclamation shall apply for calendar year 2020

classifications.rationale: The segment inseparably combines self-executing aggregate-limit rules with mandatory later grants and revocations of legally consequential relief by the Secretary.
classifications.evidence: The Secretary shall, on an expedited basis, grant relief from the quantitative limitation

classifications.rationale: The Secretary must issue administrative request procedures, and the provision assigns their treatment under an internal regulatory-management executive order.
classifications.evidence: the Secretary shall issue procedures for the requests for relief

classifications.rationale: Alongside ministerial CBP implementation and counting, the segment itself fixes the entry deadline and bars additional relief for covered articles before 2021.
classifications.evidence: further relief may not be granted for such article by the Secretary under clause 1 of Proclamation 9777

classifications.rationale: The provision itself subjects qualifying steel articles to a specified HTSUS duty treatment.
classifications.evidence: shall be subject to the duty treatment provided in subheading 9903.80.62

classifications.rationale: The President directly amends operative HTSUS text governing import treatment.
classifications.evidence: is amended by striking "9903.80.61" and inserting in its place "9903.80.62"

classifications.rationale: The President directly amends operative HTSUS text to include an additional subheading.
classifications.evidence: is amended by striking, in the last sentence, "and 9903.80.61"

classifications.rationale: The President directly amends operative HTSUS text governing the covered range of tariff subheadings.
classifications.evidence: is amended by striking, in the first sentence, "and 9903.80.61"

classifications.rationale: The President directly modifies the HTSUS, establishes when those modifications legally apply to entered goods, and supersedes inconsistent prior provisions.
classifications.evidence: shall be effective with respect to goods entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption
